scene: Inferno III — the banner of the uncommitted
story: After the gate Dante hears many voices crying
Virgil explains they are souls who refused to take a side, with neutral angels
The souls race after a banner that never rests
Wasps and flies sting them; tears and blood fall toward worms
Virgil urges Dante to look and pass on
The travelers approach the Acheron shore

cipher.contrast: Dante chooses to follow Virgil; the uncommitted follow a perpetually moving banner
